en.label: Web Frontend
en.description: User interface layer (React / Next.js) rendered in the client browser.

id.label: Web Frontend
id.description: Lapisan antarmuka pengguna (React / Next.js) yang dirender di browser client.

en.label: API Gateway / Route
en.description: HTTP entrypoint routing requests and validating contract parameters.

id.label: API Gateway / Route
id.description: Pintu masuk HTTP untuk mengarahkan request dan memvalidasi parameter.

en.label: Auth Service
en.description: Authentication middleware verifying JWT tokens and user session permissions.

id.label: Auth Service
id.description: Middleware autentikasi yang memverifikasi token JWT dan hak akses sesi pengguna.

en.label: Application Backend
en.description: Core business logic service processing calculations and data validation.

id.label: Application Backend
id.description: Layanan logika bisnis utama yang memproses kalkulasi dan validasi data.

en.label: In-Memory Cache
en.description: Ultra-fast key-value store reducing repeated database queries under high traffic.

id.label: In-Memory Cache
id.description: Penyimpanan key-value cepat untuk mengurangi kueri database berulang saat trafik tinggi.

en.label: Job Queue
en.description: Asynchronous message queue offloading long-running tasks from the main thread.

id.label: Job Queue
id.description: Antrean pesan asinkron untuk memindahkan tugas berat dari thread utama.

en.label: Relational Database
en.description: Persistent SQL storage saving structured records and transactional data.

id.label: Relational Database
id.description: Penyimpanan SQL persisten untuk menyimpan data terstruktur dan transaksi.

en.title: Build the Basic Web Stack
en.description: Construct a standard web system topology that receives user input in the browser, routes the request through an API endpoint, executes business logic, and saves the record into persistent storage.
en.hint: Flow should move from client interface -> API route -> business logic -> database storage.

id.title: Bangun Web Stack Dasar
id.description: Susun topologi sistem web standar yang menerima input di browser, mengarahkan request lewat API, memproses logika bisnis, dan menyimpan data ke penyimpanan persisten.
id.hint: Alur bergerak dari antarmuka client -> rute API -> logika bisnis -> penyimpanan database.

en.title: Authenticated Application System
en.description: Build a secure architecture where incoming client requests must verify user authentication and session permissions before accessing private API endpoints and business backend services.
en.hint: Authentication verification must occur before API processing reaches backend database services.

id.title: Sistem Aplikasi Terautentikasi
id.description: Susun arsitektur aman di mana request client harus memverifikasi autentikasi pengguna dan hak akses sesi sebelum mengakses rute API privat dan layanan backend.
id.hint: Verifikasi autentikasi harus terjadi sebelum pemrosesan API mencapai database backend.

en.title: High-Performance Caching Layer
en.description: Design an optimized architecture for high-traffic web applications that checks fast in-memory cache before hitting the primary relational database.
en.hint: Backend logic checks fast memory cache ahead of heavy relational database queries.

id.title: Lapisan Cache Performa Tinggi
id.description: Rancang arsitektur optimal untuk aplikasi web ber-trafik tinggi yang mengecek memori cache cepat sebelum mengakses database relasional utama.
id.hint: Logika backend mengecek memori cache cepat sebelum kueri database relasional yang berat.

en.title: Asynchronous Background Processing
en.description: Build an architecture that offloads heavy background processing (such as email dispatch or report generation) into a job queue to keep HTTP response times fast.
en.hint: Heavy long-running jobs are dispatched to a queue before persistent storage processing.

id.title: Pemrosesan Latar Belakang Asinkron
id.description: Susun arsitektur yang memindahkan proses berat (seperti pengiriman email atau pembentukan laporan) ke antrean pesan agar waktu respon HTTP tetap cepat.
id.hint: Tugas berat asinkron dikirim ke antrean queue sebelum proses penyimpanan persisten.
